description: Boy Grade 3 English — Batch 4: Food, Jobs, Action Verbs, Numbers 20-100, Telling Time

lessons.title: Food and Meals
lessons.learningObjective: After this lesson, Johnny will know 3 meal names and 8 food words in English.
lessons.shortExplanation: Learn food and meal words in English. Con học tên các bữa ăn và thức ăn bằng tiếng Anh!
lessons.content:
## The Three Meals
- **breakfast** (bữa sáng) — the first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning
- **lunch** (bữa trưa) — the midday meal, eaten around noon
- **dinner** (bữa tối) — the evening meal, usually the biggest meal

## Food Words
- **rice** (cơm / gạo) — a white grain eaten with chopsticks in Vietnam
- **egg** (trứng) — a food from chickens, can be fried or boiled
- **bread** (bánh mì) — a baked food made from flour
- **milk** (sữa) — a white drink that makes bones strong
- **noodle soup** (phở / bún) — a Vietnamese dish with broth and noodles
- **mango** (quả xoài) — a sweet yellow tropical fruit
- **fish** (cá) — a popular food in Vietnam, eaten at lunch or dinner

## Useful Phrases
- I eat **breakfast** at 7 a.m.
- I have **rice** and **fish** for **lunch**.
- I drink **milk** every morning.
- **Mango** is my favourite fruit!

## Summary
We eat three meals every day: breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Rice, eggs, bread, and noodle soup are common foods. Eat a healthy breakfast to have energy for school!
lessons.storyContext: ROBO prepares a meal plan for Johnny to fuel his training at the Robot Sport Lab and they learn all the food names in English.

checks.text: What is the first meal of the day?
checks.explanation: Breakfast is the first meal. You eat it in the morning. Breakfast = bữa sáng.
checks.hint: This meal happens right after you wake up.

checks.text: What is the midday meal called?
checks.explanation: Lunch is the midday meal eaten around noon. Lunch = bữa trưa.
checks.hint: You eat this meal in the middle of the day.

checks.text: What is 'cơm' in English?
checks.explanation: Cơm = Rice in English. It is a staple food in Vietnam, eaten with chopsticks.
checks.hint: Vietnamese people eat cơm with almost every meal.

checks.text: What is 'trứng' in English?
checks.explanation: Trứng = Egg in English. Eggs come from chickens and can be fried, boiled, or scrambled.
checks.hint: Trứng is round and can be fried for breakfast.

checks.text: 'Phở' is a type of Vietnamese ___.
checks.explanation: Phở is a Vietnamese noodle soup with broth and herbs. It is very popular for breakfast.
checks.hint: Phở has noodles in a warm, flavoured broth.

checks.text: What drink helps make your bones strong?
checks.explanation: Milk contains calcium which helps build strong bones. Milk = sữa.
checks.hint: This white drink comes from cows.

checks.text: Which of these is a fruit?
checks.explanation: Mango is a sweet tropical fruit. Mango = quả xoài. Carrots, potatoes, and onions are vegetables.
checks.hint: This sweet yellow tropical food grows on trees.

checks.text: Which meal do most people eat in the evening?
checks.explanation: Dinner is the evening meal. Dinner = bữa tối. It is usually the biggest meal of the day.
checks.hint: This meal happens in the evening, usually after 5 p.m.

checks.text: Breakfast is the first meal of the day.
checks.explanation: True! Breakfast is the first meal eaten in the morning. Breakfast = bữa sáng.
checks.hint: Which meal do you eat first when you wake up?

checks.text: I eat ___ with chopsticks in Vietnam.
checks.explanation: Rice is the main food eaten with chopsticks in Vietnam. Rice = cơm.
checks.hint: The white grain that Vietnamese people eat at every meal.

lessons.title: Jobs and Community Helpers
lessons.learningObjective: After this lesson, Johnny will know 7 job names in English and can describe what each person does.
lessons.shortExplanation: Learn the names of jobs and what each person does. Con học tên các nghề nghiệp bằng tiếng Anh!
lessons.content:
## Job Words
- **teacher** (giáo viên) — teaches students at school
- **doctor** (bác sĩ) — helps sick people at a hospital
- **farmer** (nông dân) — grows food on a farm
- **cook** (đầu bếp) — prepares food in a kitchen or restaurant
- **driver** (tài xế) — drives vehicles to take people places
- **police officer** (cảnh sát) — protects people and keeps streets safe
- **shopkeeper** (người bán hàng) — sells things in a shop

## What Do They Do?
- A **teacher** teaches. (Giáo viên dạy học.)
- A **doctor** treats patients. (Bác sĩ chữa bệnh.)
- A **farmer** grows vegetables and rice. (Nông dân trồng rau và lúa.)
- A **cook** cooks meals. (Đầu bếp nấu ăn.)

## Useful Phrases
- What do you want to be? (Bạn muốn làm nghề gì?)
- I want to be a **teacher**. (Tôi muốn làm giáo viên.)
- My dad is a **driver**. (Ba tôi là tài xế.)

## Summary
Community helpers do important jobs for everyone. Teachers help us learn. Doctors keep us healthy. Farmers grow our food. What job do you want to have when you grow up?
lessons.storyContext: ROBO introduces Johnny to workers at the Robot Sport Lab and Johnny learns the English job title for each person.

checks.text: Who teaches students at school?
checks.explanation: A teacher teaches students at school. Teacher = giáo viên.
checks.hint: This person works at a school and explains lessons.

checks.text: Who helps sick people at a hospital?
checks.explanation: A doctor helps sick people at a hospital. Doctor = bác sĩ.
checks.hint: This person works at a bệnh viện.

checks.text: What does a farmer do?
checks.explanation: A farmer grows food like rice, vegetables, and fruit on a farm. Farmer = nông dân.
checks.hint: A farmer works on a farm in the countryside.

checks.text: What does a cook do?
checks.explanation: A cook prepares food in a kitchen or restaurant. Cook = đầu bếp.
checks.hint: You find a cook in a kitchen or restaurant.

checks.text: Who drives a bus to take people around the city?
checks.explanation: A driver drives vehicles. A bus driver takes passengers to different places. Driver = tài xế.
checks.hint: This person's job is to drive a vehicle.

checks.text: 'Thầy giáo / cô giáo' means what in English?
checks.explanation: Thầy giáo / cô giáo = Teacher in English. They teach students every day.
checks.hint: The person who teaches at a trường học.

checks.text: Who protects our streets and catches criminals?
checks.explanation: A police officer protects people, keeps streets safe, and catches criminals. Police officer = cảnh sát.
checks.hint: This person wears a uniform and keeps us safe.

checks.text: What job works in a shop and sells things to customers?
checks.explanation: A shopkeeper works in a shop and sells goods to customers. Shopkeeper = người bán hàng.
checks.hint: You meet this person when you go to buy something.

checks.text: A doctor works at a hospital.
checks.explanation: True! A doctor works at a hospital. Doctor = bác sĩ, hospital = bệnh viện.
checks.hint: Where does a bác sĩ work?

checks.text: My mum is a ___. She teaches students every day.
checks.explanation: Someone who teaches students is called a teacher. Teacher = giáo viên.
checks.hint: The job that involves teaching students.

lessons.title: Action Verbs
lessons.learningObjective: After this lesson, Johnny will know 8 action verbs in English and can use them to describe physical activities.
lessons.shortExplanation: Learn action verbs like run, jump, swim, fly. Con học các động từ hành động trong tiếng Anh!
lessons.content:
## Action Verbs
- **run** (chạy) — to move quickly on your feet
- **jump** (nhảy) — to push yourself off the ground into the air
- **swim** (bơi) — to move through water using your arms and legs
- **climb** (leo / trèo) — to go up something using hands and feet
- **kick** (đá) — to hit something with your foot
- **throw** (ném) — to send something through the air with your hand
- **catch** (bắt) — to grab something moving through the air
- **fly** (bay) — to move through the air (birds, planes, insects)

## Sentences with Action Verbs
- I **run** every morning. (Tôi chạy mỗi sáng.)
- She can **jump** very high. (Cô ấy có thể nhảy rất cao.)
- He **swims** in the pool. (Anh ấy bơi ở hồ bơi.)
- Birds can **fly** in the sky. (Chim có thể bay trên bầu trời.)

## Sport Connections
- Football: **kick**, **run**, **throw** (for goalkeeper)
- Basketball: **throw**, **catch**, **jump**
- Swimming: **swim**
- Gymnastics: **jump**, **climb**

## Summary
Action verbs describe things we do with our bodies. Johnny loves sports, so he uses action verbs every day: run, jump, kick, throw, catch!
lessons.storyContext: ROBO coaches Johnny through a sports challenge, calling out action verb commands that Johnny must perform.

checks.text: Which verb means to move quickly on foot?
checks.explanation: Run means to move quickly on your feet. Run = chạy in Vietnamese.
checks.hint: You do this faster than walking, using your legs.

checks.text: Which verb means to go up something high?
checks.explanation: Climb means to go up something using your hands and feet. Climb = leo / trèo.
checks.hint: You do this to go up a tree or a ladder.

checks.text: Which verb is done in water?
checks.explanation: Swim is done in water. Swim = bơi. You move through water using your arms and legs.
checks.hint: You need a pool or the sea to do this.

checks.text: In football, what do players do to the ball?
checks.explanation: In football, players kick the ball with their feet. Kick = đá.
checks.hint: You use your foot to send the ball into the goal.

checks.text: 'Nhảy' in English is?
checks.explanation: Nhảy = Jump in English. You jump by pushing yourself off the ground into the air.
checks.hint: Nhảy = push yourself up into the air.

checks.text: What do birds do that most humans cannot?
checks.explanation: Birds can fly because they have wings. Most humans cannot fly without a machine. Fly = bay.
checks.hint: Birds have wings for this special action.

checks.text: In basketball, what do you do with the ball to score?
checks.explanation: In basketball, you throw the ball into the hoop to score. Throw = ném.
checks.hint: You use your arm to send the ball through the air.

checks.text: What is the opposite action of 'catch'?
checks.explanation: Throw is the opposite of catch. Throw = ném (send away), catch = bắt (grab it).
checks.hint: One person throws, another person ___.

checks.text: A fish can swim.
checks.explanation: True! Fish swim in water. It is their main way of moving. Swim = bơi.
checks.hint: How does a fish move through water?

checks.text: I ___ into the pool every morning.
checks.explanation: You swim in a pool. Swim = bơi. It is a great morning exercise.
checks.hint: The action verb for moving through water.

lessons.title: Numbers 20 to 100
lessons.learningObjective: After this lesson, Johnny will know the English words for tens numbers from 20 to 100.
lessons.shortExplanation: Learn to say and write numbers from 20 to 100 in English. Con học đếm số từ 20 đến 100!
lessons.content:
## The Tens
- 20 = **twenty** (hai mươi)
- 30 = **thirty** (ba mươi)
- 40 = **forty** (bốn mươi) ← note: no 'u' in forty!
- 50 = **fifty** (năm mươi)
- 60 = **sixty** (sáu mươi)
- 70 = **seventy** (bảy mươi)
- 80 = **eighty** (tám mươi)
- 90 = **ninety** (chín mươi)
- 100 = **one hundred** (một trăm)

## Numbers In Between
- 21 = twenty-**one**
- 35 = thirty-**five**
- 48 = forty-**eight**
- 99 = ninety-**nine**

Pattern: say the tens, then add a hyphen and the ones.

## Example Sentences
- There are **forty** students in the hall.
- The robot scored **seventy** points!
- The price is **fifty** thousand đồng.
- Johnny ran **one hundred** metres in 14 seconds.

## Summary
Numbers 20–100 follow a pattern. Learn the tens: twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred. Then add the ones: twenty-one, thirty-five, and so on. Watch out for 'forty' — there is no 'u'!
lessons.storyContext: ROBO keeps score at the Robot Sport Lab Olympics and reads out the numbers in English for Johnny to practise.

checks.text: How do you say '20' in English?
checks.explanation: 20 = Twenty in English. Twenty = hai mươi. Not twelve (12) or thirty (30).
checks.hint: 20 = hai mươi. What is the English word?

checks.text: How many tens make '50'?
checks.explanation: 50 = five tens. There are five groups of ten in fifty. Five = năm.

checks.text: What is '70' in English?
checks.explanation: 70 = Seventy in English. Seventy = bảy mươi. Not seventeen (17) or seven (7).
checks.hint: 70 = bảy mươi. What is the English word?

checks.text: What comes next? 10, 20, 30, ___
checks.explanation: The pattern is +10 each time: 10, 20, 30, 40. The next number is 40 = forty.
checks.hint: Add 10 to 30.

checks.text: How do you write 'forty-five' as a number?
checks.explanation: Forty-five = 45. Forty = 40, five = 5, so forty-five = 40 + 5 = 45.
checks.hint: Forty = 40, five = 5. Put them together.

checks.text: '100' in English is?
checks.explanation: 100 = One hundred in English. One hundred = một trăm. Not one thousand (1000).
checks.hint: 100 = một trăm. What is the English word?

checks.text: What is 30 + 20?
checks.explanation: 30 + 20 = 50. Thirty plus twenty equals fifty. Fifty = năm mươi.
checks.hint: Thirty + twenty = ?

checks.text: Which number is between 60 and 80?
checks.explanation: 70 is between 60 and 80. 60 < 70 < 80. Seventy = bảy mươi.
checks.hint: Which number is greater than 60 but less than 80?

checks.text: 'Sixty' is the English word for the number 60.
checks.explanation: True! Sixty = 60. Sixty = sáu mươi in Vietnamese.
checks.hint: Is sixty the correct word for 60?

checks.text: 10 × 8 = ___ (write the number in digits)
checks.explanation: 10 × 8 = 80. Eighty = tám mươi. Ten times eight equals eighty.
checks.hint: Count 8 groups of 10.

lessons.title: Telling Time
lessons.learningObjective: After this lesson, Johnny will be able to say and understand the time in English using o'clock, half past, and quarter.
lessons.shortExplanation: Learn how to tell the time in English. Con học cách nói giờ bằng tiếng Anh!
lessons.content:
## Telling the Time
**O'clock** — exact hour:
- 3:00 = three **o'clock**
- 9:00 = nine **o'clock**

**Half past** — 30 minutes after the hour:
- 4:30 = **half past** four
- 7:30 = **half past** seven

**Quarter past** — 15 minutes after the hour:
- 5:15 = **quarter past** five
- 8:15 = **quarter past** eight

**Quarter to** — 15 minutes before the next hour:
- 5:45 = **quarter to** six (15 minutes before 6)
- 9:45 = **quarter to** ten

## Time in Daily Life
- 7:00 → I wake up at **seven o'clock**.
- 7:30 → I eat breakfast at **half past seven**.
- 8:15 → School starts at **quarter past eight**.
- 12:00 → Lunch is at **twelve o'clock**.

## Summary
Telling time in English uses four main patterns: o'clock (exact hour), half past (30 minutes after), quarter past (15 minutes after), and quarter to (15 minutes before). Practice saying the time every morning!
lessons.storyContext: ROBO shows Johnny a clock and helps him practise saying the time in English so he is never late for Robot Sport Lab training.

checks.text: How do you say '3:00' in English?
checks.explanation: 3:00 = Three o'clock. 'O'clock' is used for exact hours with no extra minutes.
checks.hint: When the minute hand points to 12, it is ___ o'clock.

checks.text: How do you say '4:30'?
checks.explanation: 4:30 = Half past four. 'Half past' means 30 minutes after the hour.
checks.hint: 30 minutes = half an hour = half ___.

checks.text: 'Quarter past five' means which time?
checks.explanation: Quarter past five = 5:15. 'Quarter' = 15 minutes. Quarter PAST = 15 minutes AFTER the hour.
checks.hint: Quarter = 15 minutes. Past = after the hour.

checks.text: 'Quarter to six' means which time?
checks.explanation: Quarter to six = 5:45. 'Quarter to' = 15 minutes BEFORE the next hour. 15 minutes before 6:00 = 5:45.
checks.hint: Quarter TO six = 15 minutes BEFORE six.

checks.text: How many minutes are in one hour?
checks.explanation: There are 60 minutes in one hour. 60 phút = 1 giờ.
checks.hint: Count the minutes on a clock from 12 all the way around.

checks.text: 'It is seven thirty.' What does this mean?
checks.explanation: Seven thirty = 7:30. Thirty minutes = half an hour, so 7:30 = half past seven.
checks.hint: Thirty = 30 minutes past the hour.

checks.text: 'Half past' always means how many minutes past the hour?
checks.explanation: Half past = 30 minutes past. Half of one hour (60 minutes) = 30 minutes.
checks.hint: Half of 60 minutes = ?

checks.text: 'It is nine o'clock.' What is the time?
checks.explanation: Nine o'clock = 9:00. O'clock means exactly on the hour, with zero extra minutes.
checks.hint: O'clock = exactly on the hour, no extra minutes.

checks.text: 'Half past seven' means 7:30.
checks.explanation: True! Half past seven = 7:30. Half past = 30 minutes after the hour.
checks.hint: Half past seven: 30 minutes after 7:00 = ?

checks.text: '8:00' in words is 'eight ___'.
checks.explanation: 8:00 = eight o'clock. 'O'clock' is used when the time is exactly on the hour.
checks.hint: The word used when there are no extra minutes.
